item.text: {"paper_id":"paper070","profile_id":"cardiovascular","relevance":3,"evidence_quote":"Viral myocarditis (VM) is a cardiac inflammatory condition caused by viral infection and serves as a critical precursor to life-threatening complications, such as dilated cardiomyopathy and heart failure.","rationale":"The study directly investigates mechanisms of myocardial injury in viral myocarditis and proposes therapeutic targets, closely aligning with cardiovascular disease, heart failure, and therapies for cardiovascular outcomes.","scope_ambiguous":false,"ambiguity_note":""}
